entries.text: Ashfield Labs registers one purpose statement for its catalogue and defers the ingredient classification of each item to that item's registered product record.
Ashfield Focus Blend: a powdered drink mix in a resealable tin. The registered listing records neither a documented intended use nor an ingredient classification.
Registered product terms. Intended use: daily focus support during study sessions. Ingredient classification: each serving contains stimulant compounds including caffeine anhydrous and synephrine.
